declarationStatuses.description:
The current status of each declaration made for this visit, keyed by declaration type.

Each entry maps a declaration type (e.g. VISIT, SECURITY, WASTE, DANGEROUS_GOODS, CREW_AND_PASSENGERS, HEALTH, SHIP_STORES) to its latest status:
- DECLARED: the declaration has been submitted and is awaiting a response from the receiving authority.
- ACCEPTED: the declaration has been accepted by the receiving authority.
- REJECTED: the declaration has been rejected by the receiving authority.

A declaration type is only present in the map once it has been declared at least once; if a type is absent, no declaration of that type has been made for this visit. When a declaration is re-submitted, the map reflects the status of the most recent submission.

DANGEROUS_GOODS is only included when dangerous goods are enabled for the visit, and its status is aggregated from all dangerous goods declarations: if any single dangerous goods declaration is rejected, the overall DANGEROUS_GOODS status is reported as REJECTED.
